timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.89 today, down 25 cents from a month ago and up $1.20 from a year ago, according to AAA, and Springfield averages $3.87. Your wallet finally caught a break.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Fall firearms turkey season ends Saturday, Oct. 31. Last call for the gobblers.

timely.label: Halloween
timely.line: Halloween is Saturday, Oct. 31. Time to hide the good candy.

timely.label: Clocks Fall Back
timely.line: Daylight saving time ends Sunday, Nov. 1, so clocks fall back one hour and sunset comes an hour earlier. Enjoy the extra hour of sleep, parents.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is Wednesday, Nov. 11. Time to say thank you.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, Nov. 13. Final days in the stand.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, Nov. 14, and runs through Nov. 24. Orange vests ready.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, Nov. 26. Stretchy pants are officially on the list.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season opens Friday, Nov. 27, and runs through Nov. 29. Perfect weekend for the next generation.

timely.label: Black Friday
timely.line: Black Friday is Friday, Nov. 27. Pack snacks and patience.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Missouri will require a new Nonresident Public Land Deer Hunting Permit for out-of-state hunters starting in 2027, and it will cost $165. Out-of-towners will be paying to play.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: A Budget Bytes guide shows how to feed eight people a complete holiday dinner for around $45 using smart grocery swaps. That's a Thanksgiving budget even Dad can love.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Missouri hunters are encouraged to have deer sampled for chronic wasting disease all season at sites including Conservation Department offices, meat processors, taxidermists and freezer drops. Check before you stock the freezer.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster caught her biggest fish on a solo camping trip, then filleted it that night and cooked it over the campfire. Dinner doesn't get fresher.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad says he got the kids up, made lunch, did drop-off, worked all day and even closed new business. All before the school bell rang twice.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster who is a vet says pet insurance "saves lives" for dogs, cats and exotic pets. Fur babies get health plans too.
